rules.key: worth over 750 points a Pirate Prince must be included
rules.text: If the fleet is worth over 750 points a Pirate Prince must be included to lead it.

rules.key: adds +2 to its Leadership, to a maximum of 10
rules.text: You may include 1 Pirate Prince in your fleet, who must be assigned to a ship and adds +2 to its Leadership, to a maximum of 10.
rules.why: Sijoittelu ja johtajuuden yläraja ratkaistaan pelissa.

rules.key: Your fleet may be led by an Eldar Hero, in place of its normal fleet commander
rules.text: Your fleet may be led by an Eldar Hero, in place of its normal fleet commander.
rules.why: Valvottu 10.9.2026 (laivastopistokoe S5, raportti 17): Hero tayttaa pakollisen Pirate Princen (mandatory_at-pick kattaa molemmat osiot) ja Prince + Hero on enintaan yksi. Aiemmin Heron johtama yli 750 pisteen laivasto sai virheen 'Pirate Prince missing'.

rules.key: Only a fleet led by an Eldar Hero may take reserves
rules.text: Your fleet may be led by an Eldar Hero, in place of its normal fleet commander. Only a fleet led by an Eldar Hero may take reserves from the Craftworld Eldar fleet list.
rules.why: 1.1 (14.9.2026): sama saanto kuin RESERVES AND ALLIES -osion lause, kirjan toisessa kohdassa. Valvotaan listan res_ok-luvalla, jonka ehto on Eldar Hero. Ehdollinen reserve-oikeus; sovellus ei mallinna reserveja.

rules.key: escorts in your fleet in squadrons of 2
rules.text: You may include any number of escorts in your fleet in squadrons of 2-6 unless specified (see pg. 13).

rules.key: any mix of Darkstar fighters and Eagle bombers
rules.text: Any ship with launch bays may choose to have them launch any mix of Darkstar fighters and Eagle bombers. Ships with torpedo tubes are armed with Eldar torpedoes.

rules.key: Dragonship or Wraithship may be taken for every three cruisers
rules.text: Following this, one Craftworld Eldar Flame of Asuryan, Dragonship or Wraithship may be taken for every three cruisers in the fleet.

rules.key: no more than one for every three escort vessels in the fleet
rules.text: Craftworld Eldar Shadowhunters may be taken in the same ratio of no more than one for every three escort vessels in the fleet.

rules.key: Corsair Eldar escorts and Shadowhunters may not be in the same squadron
rules.text: Corsair Eldar escorts and Shadowhunters may not be in the same squadron.

rules.key: If the Flame of Asuryan is taken, the Eldar Hero must be embarked aboard it
rules.text: If the Flame of Asuryan is taken, the Eldar Hero must be embarked aboard it.

rules.key: up to one battleship for every full 1,000 points
rules.text: Your fleet may include up to one battleship for every full 1,000 points it contains. Therefore, if you have between 0 to 999 points, you cannot field any battleships, while from 1000 to 1,999 points you can include one, and so on.
rules.why: Ei jasentynyt ennen 7.9.2026: kaava luki 'include' ennen 'up to' -jatkoa, jolloin lukusanaksi tuli 'up', ja sana 'full' katkaisi pisteluvun. PYORISTYS: kirja sanoo 'FULL 1,000 points' ja antaa esimerkin 0-999 = ei yhtaan, 1000-1999 = yksi. Sovellus pyoristi 7.9.2026 asti ylospain kuten muut pisterajat, jolloin 500 pisteen laivastossa sai yhden taistelulaivan. Nyt saannolla on oma lippunsa (full) ja vain se pyoristaa alaspain ilman vahimmaismaaraa.

rules.key: An Eldar Hero must lead the fleet in order to use Craftworld Eldar vessels as reserves
rules.text: An Eldar Hero must lead the fleet in order to use Craftworld Eldar vessels as reserves.
rules.why: 1.1 (14.9.2026): listan kentta res_ok, jossa lupa on ehdollinen (needs_re = Eldar Hero tai Prince Yriel). Eldar ja Craftworld Eldar ovat s.14:n rotuluettelossa eri rotuja, joten ilman tata lupaa rotuportti estaisi koko asian. Suhdeluvut tulevat kirjan yleisesta 1:3-saannosta (s.14).

rules.key: Yriel may be taken instead of the Hero Fleet Commander
rules.text: Yriel may be taken instead of the Hero Fleet Commander as listed in the Corsair and Craftworld Eldar fleet lists.
rules.why: J161, pelaajaraportti 9.10.2026: laatikko on painettu Iyandenin sivulle 319, mutta lause nimeaa Corsair-listat. Yriel-rivi (150 pts, 1 re-roll hinnassa) on listan RESERVES AND ALLIES -osiossa, ja han on yksi kolmesta komentajasta (Pirate Prince, Eldar Hero tai Yriel); pakollinen komentaja (yli 750) tayttyy hanella.

rules.key: if the Flame of Asuryan with Yriel is added to the parent fleet it is exempt from the reserve rules
rules.text: Furthermore, if the Flame of Asuryan with Yriel is added to the parent fleet it is exempt from the reserve rules *eg you do not have to field three capital ships in a Corsair Eldar fleet list(.
rules.why: Moottorissa (domain.js resolveFleet, listan kentta res_exempt): Flame of Asuryan reservina ei kuluta 1:3-budjettia, kun laivastoa johtaa Prince Yriel. Vain Flame ja vain Yrielin kanssa: Hero tarvitsee yha kolme risteilijaa ja Dragonship on tavallinen reservi. Kirjan lauseessa on painovirhe sulkeissa ('*eg ... list(').

rules.key: He must be embarked aboard the Flame of Asuryan if it is present
rules.text: He must be embarked aboard the Flame of Asuryan if it is present, in which case his cost is 125 points.
rules.why: Rivi 'Embarked aboard the Flame of Asuryan' (-25) on pelaajan rasti; resolveFleet vertaa sen laivastoon (listan kentta aboard): Flame ilman rastia on huomautus (25 pistetta liikaa), rasti ilman Flamea on virhe.

notes: Kirjassa on KAKSI Eldar Corsairs -listaa: sivun 316 otsikko on 'GOTHIC SECTOR' ja sivun 317 'LATER GOTHIC WAR'. Ne olivat 7.9.2026 asti sulautettuina yhdeksi, jolloin listassa oli kaksi identtista Pirate Prince- ja Eldar Hero -osiota. Sama vika kuin Grey Knightsissa.
Komentajaosiot ovat sanasta sanaan samat molemmilla listoilla. Huomaa etta 'One re-roll' maksaa Pirate Princella 25 ja Eldar Herolla 50 - sama nimi, eri hinta, eri osio.
Tama on laajempi versio: mukana Void Stalker -taistelulaiva seka Aurora- ja Solaris-kevytristeilijat.
